text.tspan: Fast live coding assistance + async eval-gated strategy promotion.
Two entry paths: browser sessions use WebRTC/Daily; phone-based coding assistance uses Twilio. Both stay colocated with the same realtime voice pipeline.
2. LOW-LATENCY REALTIME VOICE LAYER: DAILY / PIPECAT / TWILIO
Do not split this path across clouds: Developer -> WebRTC/Twilio -> Pipecat -> ASR -> LLM -> TTS -> Developer.
NVIDIA-hosted NIM APIs first; self-hosted NIM/Riva on GPU later
Pipecat/Daily realtime orchestration + Twilio telephony for browser and phone-based coding assistance.
One pipeline: WebRTC/Twilio -> Pipecat -> ASR -> LLM -> TTS; barge-in, fallback routing, latency/dropped-turn telemetry.
spoken response streams back over the same WebRTC session
fallback routing: cached phrase or alternate TTS
REDIS ON GCP MEMORystore NOW -> AWS ELASTICACHE LATER
Events: transcript.final | failure_mode.detected | strategy.failed | eval_case.generated | strategy.promoted | strategy.rollback
Agents consume Redis Streams and write typed events back. They are not a direct chain.
selects guidance, analogy, quiz, retry with plan
4. CEKURA-STYLE SELF-IMPROVEMENT LOOP: Failure -> Promoted Coding Strategy
Simulation, replay, regression testing, monitoring, and gated promotion. The assistant improves by promoting tested strategy versions, not by live fine-tuning.
follow-up answer correctness | fewer guidance steps | failure pattern resolved
lower latency | higher confidence | better rubric score
5. GCP PROTOTYPE CONTROL PLANE + AWS PRODUCTION TARGET
Prototype can run on GCP for speed. Production target maps to AWS. Realtime voice stays colocated; async eval/replay can run in either cloud.
not blocking realtime unless latency passes
Do not split live voice across clouds.
Keep WebRTC/Twilio, Pipecat, ASR, LLM, and TTS colocated.
Hybrid-cloud note: GCP prototype for speed; AWS target for production. Realtime voice stays colocated.
Async eval/replay workers can move clouds because they do not block live coding assistance.
Legend: red = realtime | blue dashed = async event/data | green = eval-gated promotion | gray dotted = fallback/rollback
Daily + Twilio = voice ingress | Cekura = eval loop | NVIDIA = model runtime | GCP now -> AWS target
